split_unit: whole engine source trajectory and whole preregistered context pair
selection_data: discovery trajectories x discovery context pairs only
confirmation_data: evaluation trajectories x evaluation context pairs only

action_probe.probe: L2 logistic regression on discovery-only variance-selected SAE features
action_probe.interpretation: predictive association only; AUC is not a causal or semantic explanation

action_flip_feature_selection.target: discovery-only standardized separation of absolute context-code deltas in action-flip versus stable pairs; matched log-odds-delta correlation is the tie-break
action_flip_feature_selection.fallback_if_no_discovery_flips: ranking reduces to discovery log-odds-delta correlation; this must not be labeled flip mining

limitations: Probe performance is association, not causal XAI.
Feature selection and dose calibration never use held-out context pairs or trajectories.
A steering effect supports a local causal role only if it exceeds matched controls and reverses with sign/dose.
A fixed-state effect does not estimate downstream live-trajectory payoff effects.
